nodes.label: Patient presented with cough, dyspnea, and chest pain
42-year-old woman with metastases to the brain and bone and a history of multiple lines of treatment
Symptoms initially included cough and dyspnea, which were temporarily relieved but later returned along with chest pain
No detailed physical examination findings were provided in the case report
CT imaging shows a lung lesion with alveolar septal changes and pleural effusion
Follow-up CT shows enlargement of the lung lesion with more nodules and pleural effusion
Plasma cfDNA and pleural fluid NGS findings support metastatic pulmonary involvement
Malignant pleural effusion secondary to metastatic disease
Pleural cytology, biopsy, and D-dimer/CTPA results remain unretrieved or pending (retrieval limit reached)
No CTPA or D-dimer evidence supporting pulmonary thromboembolism is available
No infection markers supporting pulmonary infection are available
No drug exposure history supporting drug-induced lung injury is reported
